tasks.title: Conversation #66
tasks.transcript:
Man: So did you manage to get those tickets for the theater?
Woman: Yes, I got some great seats near the stage for Friday evening.
Man: That's fantastic. What play did you say it is?
Woman: It's a modern adaptation of Shakespeare's King Lear.
Man: Oh, that sounds interesting.
Woman: I think so too. I read King Lear in high school, but I've never seen it performed and I find the idea of a modern adaptation really intriguing. I sure hope my sister does too.

questions.stem: What is unusual about the performance of King Lear?

options.C: It will be performed by high school students.
options.D: It is in a foreign language.

questions.analysis: 答案: B 题目问的是: 这场《李尔王》的演出有什么特别之处？ 定位原文: Woman: "It's a modern adaptation of Shakespeare's King Lear." / "...I find the idea of a modern adaptation really intriguing." 选项分析: A. It will be held outdoors. (将在户外举行。) - 错误。文中未提及地点是户外。 B. It is a modern adaptation. (它是现代改编版。) - 正确。女士明确提到这是 "modern adaptation"。 C. It will be performed by high school students. (将由高中生表演。) - 错误。女士提到她在高中读过原著，不是说表演者是高中生。 D. It is in a foreign language. (是用外语表演的。) - 错误。文中未提及语言问题。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the woman's sister?

options.A: She is paying for the woman's theater ticket.
options.B: She is an expert on William Shakespeare.
options.C: She has never read King Lear.
options.D: She will be joining the woman at the theater.

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 关于女士的妹妹，可以推断出什么？ 定位原文: Woman: "I sure hope my sister does too." (紧接着提到妹妹对现代改编版的看法) 选项分析: A. She is paying for the woman's theater ticket. (她正在为女士的戏票买单。) - 错误。文中无此信息。 B. She is an expert on William Shakespeare. (她是莎士比亚专家。) - 错误。文中无此信息。 C. She has never read King Lear. (她从未读过《李尔王》。) - 错误。文中只说女士自己读过，未提及妹妹是否读过。 D. She will be joining the woman at the theater. (她将和女士一起去剧院。) - 正确。女士买了票，并说 "I sure hope my sister does too"（希望我妹妹也觉得有趣），暗示妹妹是同行者，女士希望妹妹也会喜欢这场演出。
